stemMd: Which treaty-created community came into operation on 1 January 1958?

options.label: C
options.textMd: The European Coal and Steel Community

explanationMd: The EEC followed the 1957 signing of the Treaties of Rome and began in 1958. Treaty signature and institutional operation can fall in different years. The other organisations have different founding dates.

distractorRationale.b: It arose after the First World War.
